attributes.residual:
BASELINE (live, reproduced the prior record exactly): fuzzy 72.3306%, real 947, insns T611/O626, multiset 91t, frame T192/O160. BEST (kept): fuzzy 80.3666%, real 832, insns T611/O587, multiset 56t, frame T192/O240. That is +8.04 fuzzy points on the largest-impact function in Game Code.

THE AXIS IS NOW BRACKETED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, which is the durable finding. All-scalar (24 separate locals) = real 947. Array with constant indices = real 832. Array accessed through a pointer (full memory residency) = real 1061, and its --ops INVERTS the signature: ours-only -17 stw -21 lwz -18 cmplwi against target-only +16 rlwinm.. So target is NEITHER all-fused NOR all-spilled: it fuses the value-and-test into `rlwinm.` at MOST sites and stores/reloads at only about five. The prior record's mechanism sentence (target ALWAYS materialises, spills and reloads) is therefore too strong and is CORRECTED here -- it was read off a handful of sites and generalised.

REMAINING RESIDUAL, one named mechanism: PARTIAL edge-value residency. At the kept state --ops reads target-only +11 stw +10 lwz +5 rlwinm +4 cmpwi +3 cmplwi +2 clrlwi +1 clrrwi +1 slwi +1 bgt +1 blt +1 bne against ours-only -4 rlwinm. -2 clrlwi. -1 clrrwi. -1 srwi. -3 li -2 beq -2 bge -1 addi. The ~11 stw / 10 lwz are about five sites' worth of store+reload, clustered at target @0x608, @0x630-0x650, @0x658, @0x670-0x690, @0x698. Ours still uses the fused dot-form at exactly those five. Frame also overshoots: T192 vs O240, i.e. the 24-element array is 8 slots MORE storage than target declares, consistent with target holding roughly 19-20 of these in memory rather than 24.

NEXT AGENT: the open question is WHICH SUBSET is memory-resident, not whether any is -- that is settled. Do NOT re-probe: guard polarity (closed twice, positively), the empty-bodied-if form (law-vetoed), whole-array pointer access (measured, real 1061), or index renumbering (measured byte-identical). The untried shape is a SMALLER array plus a few remaining scalars -- the slot and frame arithmetic both point at about 19-20 array members with the rest scalar -- but which four or five stay scalar is not derivable from the evidence gathered, so treat it as a search, not a finding.
